verdict.rationale: Data region/residency is a fair axis for a hosted voice-agent SaaS platform, but the evidence pack never mentions choosing a storage region or data residency. The retention settings (how long transcripts and audio are kept) and HIPAA/BAA eligibility are adjacent privacy controls, not location choice, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
